title: Exploring accurate structure, composition and thermophysical properties of η carbides in 17.90 wt% W-4.15 wt% Cr-1.10 wt% V-0.69 wt% C steel
abstract: The heat resistance of the η carbides is important for red hardness and hot strength of high tungsten iron-base alloys. The crystal structure and exact composition of η carbides in this work are revealed to be cubic, Fe3.01W2.33Cr0.38V0.28C1.06 by extraction, X-ray diffraction refinement and electron probe micro-analysis. Defect formation energy calculations show that Cr and V occupy W sites in the lattice. Cr and V decrease the mechanical properties and weaken the elastic heat resistance of η carbides, which is attributed to the CCr and CV bonds weaker than CW bonds and the CCr bonds population decrease at high temperature.
